name: Global
description: Contains top-level properties and methods that don't need to be preceded by the Application property.
remarks: The following two statements have the same result. One statement uses the Application property to access the Documents collection, and one does not. Both statements are equal and achieve the same result.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Global object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns name of the specified object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Documents
properties.description: Returns a Documents collection that represents all the open documents. Read-only.

properties.name: Windows
properties.description: Returns a Windows collection that represents all open document windows. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveDocument
properties.description: Returns a Document object that represents the active document (the document with the focus). Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveWindow
properties.description: Returns a Window object that represents the active window (the window with the focus). Read-only.

properties.name: Selection
properties.description: Returns a Selection object that represents a selected range or the insertion point. Read-only.

properties.name: WordBasic
properties.description: Returns an Automation object (Word.Basic) that includes methods for all the WordBasic statements and functions available in Word version 6.0 and Word for Windows 95. Read-only.

properties.name: PrintPreview
properties.description: True if print preview is the current view. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RecentFiles
properties.description: Returns a RecentFiles collection that represents the most recently accessed files.

properties.name: NormalTemplate
properties.description: Returns a Template object that represents the Normal template.

properties.name: System
properties.description: Returns a System object, which can be used to return system-related information and perform system-related tasks.

properties.name: AutoCorrect
properties.description: Returns an AutoCorrect object that contains the current AutoCorrect options, entries, and exceptions. Read-only.

properties.name: FontNames
properties.description: Returns a FontNames object that includes the names of all the available fonts. Read-only.

properties.name: LandscapeFontNames
properties.description: Returns a FontNames object that includes the names of all the available landscape fonts.

properties.name: PortraitFontNames
properties.description: Returns a FontNames object that includes the names of all the available portrait fonts.

properties.name: Languages
properties.description: Returns a Languages collection that represents the proofing languages listed in the Language dialog box.

properties.name: FileConverters
properties.description: Returns a FileConverters collection that represents all the file converters available to Microsoft Word. Read-only.

properties.name: Dialogs
properties.description: Returns a Dialogs collection that represents all the built-in dialog boxes in Word. Read-only.

properties.name: CaptionLabels
properties.description: Returns a CaptionLabels collection that represents all the available caption labels. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoCaptions
properties.description: Returns an AutoCaptions collection that represents the captions that are automatically added when items such as tables and pictures are inserted into a document. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIns
properties.description: Returns an AddIns collection that represents all available add-ins, regardless of whether they're currently loaded. Read-only.

properties.name: Tasks
properties.description: Returns a Tasks collection that represents all the applications that are running.

properties.name: MacroContainer
properties.description: Returns a Template or Document object that represents the template or document in which the module that contains the running procedure is stored.

properties.name: CommandBars
properties.description: Returns a CommandBars collection that represents the menu bar and all the toolbars in Microsoft Word.

properties.name: SynonymInfo
properties.description: Returns a SynonymInfo object that contains information from the thesaurus on synonyms, antonyms, or related words and expressions for the specified word or phrase.

properties.name: VBE
properties.description: Returns a VBE object that represents the Visual Basic Editor.

properties.name: ListGalleries
properties.description: Returns a ListGalleries collection that represents the three list template galleries (Bulleted, Numbered, and Outline Numbered).

properties.name: ActivePrinter
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the active printer. Read/write String.

properties.name: Templates
properties.description: Returns a Templates collection that represents all the available templates-global templates and those attached to open documents.

properties.name: CustomizationContext
properties.description: Returns or sets a Template or Document object that represents the template or document in which changes to menu bars, toolbars, and key bindings are stored. Read/write. .

properties.name: KeyBindings
properties.description: Returns a KeyBindings collection that represents customized key assignments, which include a key code, a key category, and a command.

properties.name: KeysBoundTo
properties.description: Returns a KeysBoundTo object that represents all the key combinations assigned to the specified item.

properties.name: FindKey
properties.description: Returns a KeyBinding object that represents the specified key combination. Read-only.

properties.name: Options
properties.description: Returns an Options object that represents application settings in Microsoft Word.

properties.name: CustomDictionaries
properties.description: Returns a Dictionaries object that represents the collection of active custom dictionaries. Read-only.

properties.name: StatusBar
properties.description: This property is no longer supported in Microsoft Word Visual Basic for Applications.

properties.name: ShowVisualBasicEditor
properties.description: True if the Visual Basic Editor window is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IsObjectValid
properties.description: True if the specified variable that references an object is valid. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: HangulHanjaDictionaries
properties.description: Returns a HangulHanjaConversionDictionaries collection that represents all the active custom conversion dictionaries.

properties.name: LanguageSettings
properties.description: Returns a LanguageSettings object, which contains information about the language settings in Microsoft Word.

properties.name: AutoCorrectEmail
properties.description: Returns an AutoCorrect object that represents automatic corrections made to email messages.

properties.name: ProtectedViewWindows
properties.description: Returns a ProtectedViewWindows object that represents the open Protected View windows. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveProtectedViewWindow
properties.description: Returns a ProtectedViewWindow object that represents the active Protected View window (the Protected View window with the focus). Read-only.

properties.name: IsSandboxed
properties.description: True if the application window is a Protected View window. Read-only.

methods.name: Repeat
methods.description: Repeats the most recent editing action one or more times. Returns True if the commands were repeated successfully.

parameters.name: Times
parameters.description: The number of times you want to repeat the last command.

methods.name: DDEExecute
methods.signature: DDEExecute(Channel As Long, Command As String)
methods.description: Sends a command or series of commands to an application through the specified dynamic data exchange (DDE) channel.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The channel number returned by the DDEInitiate method.

parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: A command or series of commands recognized by the receiving application (the DDE server). If the receiving application cannot perform the specified command, an error occurs.

methods.name: DDEInitiate
methods.signature: DDEInitiate(App As String, Topic As String) As Long
methods.description: Opens a dynamic data exchange (DDE) channel to another application, and returns the channel number.

parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The name of a DDE topic—for example, the name of an open document—recognized by the application to which you are opening a channel.

methods.name: DDEPoke
methods.signature: DDEPoke(Channel As Long, Item As String, Data As String)
methods.description: Uses an open dynamic data exchange (DDE) channel to send data to an application.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The channel number returned by the DDEInitiate method.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: The item within a DDE topic to which the specified data is to be sent.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: The data to be sent to the receiving application (the DDE server).

methods.name: DDERequest
methods.signature: DDERequest(Channel As Long, Item As String) As String
methods.description: Uses an open dynamic data exchange (DDE) channel to request information from the receiving application, and returns the information as a string.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The channel number returned by the DDEInitiate method.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: The item to be requested.

methods.name: DDETerminate
methods.description: Closes the specified dynamic data exchange (DDE) channel to another application.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The channel number returned by the DDEInitiate method.

methods.name: DDETerminateAll
methods.description: Closes all dynamic data exchange (DDE) channels opened by Microsoft Word. .

methods.name: BuildKeyCode
methods.signature: BuildKeyCode(Arg1 As WdKey, [Arg2 As Variant], [Arg3 As Variant], [Arg4 As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Returns a unique number for the specified key combination.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: Arg3
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: Arg4
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

methods.name: KeyString
methods.signature: KeyString(KeyCode As Long, [KeyCode2 As Variant]) As String
methods.description: Returns the key combination string for the specified keys (for example, CTRL+SHIFT+A).

parameters.name: KeyCode
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: KeyCode2
parameters.description: A second key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

methods.name: CheckSpelling
methods.signature: CheckSpelling(Word As String, [CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant], [MainDictionary As Variant], [CustomDictionary2 As Variant], [CustomDictionary3 As Variant], [CustomDictionary4 As Variant], [CustomDictionary5 As Variant], [CustomDictionary6 As Variant], [CustomDictionary7 As Variant], [CustomDictionary8 As Variant], [CustomDictionary9 As Variant], [CustomDictionary10 As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Checks a string for spelling errors. Returns a Boolean to indicate whether the string contains spelling errors. True if the string has no spelling errors.

parameters.name: Word
parameters.description: The text whose spelling is to be checked.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True if capitalization is ignored. If this argument is omitted, the current value of the IgnoreUppercase property is used.

parameters.name: MainDictionary
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the main dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary2
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary3
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary4
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary5
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary6
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary7
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary8
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary9
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary10
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of an additional custom dictionary.

methods.name: GetSpellingSuggestions
methods.signature: GetSpellingSuggestions(Word As String, [CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant], [MainDictionary As Variant], [SuggestionMode As Variant], [CustomDictionary2 As Variant], [CustomDictionary3 As Variant], [CustomDictionary4 As Variant], [CustomDictionary5 As Variant], [CustomDictionary6 As Variant], [CustomDictionary7 As Variant], [CustomDictionary8 As Variant], [CustomDictionary9 As Variant], [CustomDictionary10 As Variant]) As SpellingSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a SpellingSuggestions collection that represents the words suggested as spelling replacements for a given word.

parameters.name: Word
parameters.description: The word whose spelling is to be checked.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True to ignore words in all uppercase letters. If this argument is omitted, the current value of the IgnoreUppercase property is used.

parameters.name: SuggestionMode
parameters.description: Specifies the way Word makes spelling suggestions. Can be one of the following WdSpellingWordType constants: wdAnagram, wdSpellword, or wdWildcard. The default value is WdSpellword.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Displays on-line Help information.

parameters.name: HelpType
parameters.description: The on-line Help topic or window. Can be any of these WdHelpType constants.

methods.name: NewWindow
methods.description: Opens a new window with the same document as the specified window. Returns a Window object.

methods.name: CleanString
methods.description: Removes nonprinting characters (character codes 1–29) and special Word characters from the specified string or changes them to spaces (character code 32), as described in the "Remarks" section. Returns the result as a String.

parameters.name: String
parameters.description: The source string.

methods.name: ChangeFileOpenDirectory
methods.description: Sets the folder in which Word searches for documents. .

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path to the folder in which Word searches for documents.

methods.name: InchesToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from inches to points (1 inch = 72 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Inches
parameters.description: The inch value to be converted to points.

methods.name: CentimetersToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from centimeters to points (1 cm = 28.35 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Centimeters
parameters.description: The centimeter value to be converted to points.

methods.name: MillimetersToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from millimeters to points (1 mm = 2.85 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Millimeters
parameters.description: The millimeter value to be converted to points.

methods.name: PicasToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from picas to points (1 pica = 12 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Picas
parameters.description: The pica value to be converted to points.

methods.name: LinesToPoints
methods.description: Converts a measurement from lines to points (1 line = 12 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Lines
parameters.description: The line value to be converted to points.

methods.name: PointsToInches
methods.description: Converts a measurement from points to inches (1 inch = 72 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The measurement, in points.

methods.name: PointsToCentimeters
methods.description: Converts a measurement from points to centimeters (1 centimeter = 28.35 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The measurement, in points.

methods.name: PointsToMillimeters
methods.description: Converts a measurement from points to millimeters (1 millimeter = 2.835 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The measurement, in points.

methods.name: PointsToPicas
methods.description: Converts a measurement from points to picas (1 pica = 12 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The measurement, in points.

methods.name: PointsToLines
methods.description: Converts a measurement from points to lines (1 line = 12 points). Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The measurement, in points.

methods.name: PointsToPixels
methods.signature: PointsToPixels(Points As Single, [fVertical As Variant]) As Single
methods.description: Converts a measurement from points to pixels. Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The point value to be converted to pixels.

parameters.name: fVertical
parameters.description: True to return the result as vertical pixels; False to return the result as horizontal pixels.

methods.name: PixelsToPoints
methods.signature: PixelsToPoints(Pixels As Single, [fVertical As Variant]) As Single
methods.description: Converts a measurement from pixels to points. Returns the converted measurement as a Single.

parameters.name: Pixels
parameters.description: The pixel value to be converted to points.

parameters.name: fVertical
parameters.description: True to convert vertical pixels; False to convert horizontal pixels.
